sources.title: Les piliers du destin
sources.quality_notes: Publisher TOC chapter 12: year/month/day/hour stem-branch calculation; ISBN9782901795988, 264pp. Earlier Les Huit Signes described as foundation; no original imprint or first western publication proof.

sources.title: The way to Chinese astrology: the four pillars of destiny
sources.quality_notes: NCID BA50619850, ISBN0041330102, xv+143pp, N. Derek Poulsen translation, John Blofeld foreword; original language French. Five Japanese holdings not five editions or acquisition dates; exact base edition unknown.

sources.title: Les huit signes de votre destin: initiation à la pratique astrologique chinoise
sources.quality_notes: OL32119048M, OCLC493394936, ISBN9782901795193, XXI+176pp. Earlier work linked by 1995 publisher; 1981 candidate not yet admitted, original leaves and specific school unresolved.

sources.title: Les quatre piliers de la destinée, volume 1
sources.quality_notes: FRBNF43872379, ISBN9782916751221, holding 2014-172589; translated/adapted from Essentials of four pillars by Mourier, Spirau, Kazourian. Base printing and rule pages unverified.

sources.title: Les quatre piliers de la destinée, volume 2
sources.quality_notes: FRBNF44401890, ISBN9782916751238, holding 2015-208840; adapted from Four pillars of destiny by Mourier, Spirau, Esnoult-Rossetti. Publisher abstract discusses ten deities, shen sha, luck pillars; not original page reading. 2021 later editions not separately admitted.

sources.title: Le Bazi, 4 piliers de la destinée: une aide pour la médecine traditionnelle chinoise
sources.quality_notes: FRBNF45268406, ISBN9782916751375, Bonin and Lautard, 127pp. Modern TCM-related publication, not clinical efficacy, actual training or ancient rule evidence.

sources.title: Astrologie Paris: formations
sources.quality_notes: Separately lists Ba Zi and Zi Wei Dou Shu enquiries; not dated first offering, delivery, instructor lineage or original course text. One carrier.

sources.title: Traditionelle chinesische Astrologie (Band 1)
sources.quality_notes: ISBN9783933257086, 576pp, German; day dominant, twelve fate palaces, symbolic stars described. FAU IKGF corroborates https://ikgf.uni-erlangen.de/people/index.shtml/manfred-kubny.shtml; one publication object, no first systematic Western textbook adjudication.

sources.title: Bazi Suanming Ausbildung
sources.quality_notes: Modern instructor attributes twelve life palaces to Ziwei Doushu; not evidence of historical borrowing, mechanical equivalence, separate Ziwei course or actual delivery.

sources.title: Learn Chinese Astrology with Richard Ashworth
sources.quality_notes: Online one-to-one four pillars offer Water Tiger 2022; no independent class delivery, student geography or named teacher transmission confirmed.

edges_rejected_or_unproved: Modern twelve-palace attribution does not prove ancient borrowing.
Announcements do not prove teaching or lineage.
Exact French translation base edition unresolved.
unresolved_lineage_questions: Vietnamese Tử vi in France; British early Ziwei; Kermadec and Goh source editions; actual courses.
